mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are holding at 61 degrees under overcast skies near Verona City Hall, with a beautiful Waxing Gibbous moon overhead.

City officials are calling for student artists in grades K through 12 to design the new I Voted sticker for our November elections. Submissions are due by July 22, and the community will vote on the top designs from July 28 through August 7.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with live music happening today at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol Square or enjoy the music series at Paddy Mac's.

In a report from the police department, officers handled several calls this week, including an incident on July 13 where a driver was arrested for an O-W-I after being found with their vehicle stuck on a large rock.
Our local Culver's is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you the delicious Chocolate Volcano flavor when they open their doors at 10 AM.
